entry.title: Nvidia snaps up Hugging Face for $12.9 billion as closed AI labs pull away
entry.summary: Nvidia is buying open-source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, about 80 times its $150 million annual revenue. The deal fits Nvidia's push to invest billions in open AI models while closed providers like OpenAI and Anthropic move away from Nvidia hardware. entry.title: Nvidia Must Prove It Can Be Tomorrow's AI Platform
entry.summary: PSP Growth Managing Director Momei Qu says Nvidia's earnings will be a key test for the AI trade, with expectations so high that simply beating estimates may not be enough for investors. As the chipmaker looks beyond its dominant data center business, Qu says, "They have to tell the investor world that they will continue to be the AI platform of tomorrow." (Source: Bloomberg)
